**S25 — scores**
- Emotion/story: 2
- Understood with sound off: 3
- Pacing: 3
- Composition / eye-line / legibility: 2

The meaning gets across through text cards, not the picture. After 8.7 s Tessa doesn't move, and the visual comparison the scene is about never happens.

**Notes**

1. **0.4–4.8 s:** The beam isn't there yet when "extra dollar of principal stops interest" is said. At 2.9 s we only see a dollar floating next to the house, and Tessa points at the roof instead of the dollar. Fix: have Tessa push the dollar into the house, or into a visible loan stack, on "principal" (1.3 s). Then start the beam rising from the house wall on "rate" (5.7 s), so the dollar rides up with it.

2. **8.7 s:** The beam floats up and to the right of the house. The tick ruler has no values or baseline, so the beam's height doesn't stand for anything and "7.40%" lives only in the caption. Fix: make the beam come out of the house's side wall. Mark the ruler's 0 at ground level and put a single 7.4% tick at the beam. Bring the caption up to full opacity by "percent" (9.3 s); at 8.7 s it's still dim.

3. **14.5 s:** "Not an investment return; it's interest she no longer pays" is shown only as a text card. Fix: show a small interest coin about to drop onto the house, blocked by the dollar on the beam, and let it fade out on "no longer pays" (15.6 s). That lets you cut most of the card.

4. **20.3–26.1 s:** The "any other use" dollar doesn't match the brief. It's a faint, dashed ghost far off to the right, nobody holds it, and it's never set against the beam. At 26.1 s it sits level with the beam about 70 px away, so there's no comparison and no tension. Fix: on "any other use" (18.2 s), have Tessa turn and hold up a solid dollar right against the beam's end. Leave its height unresolved, for example wobbling above and below the line on "risk and taxes" (25.0 s), so "isn't tested" reads as an open question. The text is also crowding the ruler at 26.1 s: shorten the "not tested" card or move it under the beam so the right-hand column is clear.
